fusions.name: Lunge from the Reeds
fusions.desc: Springs you at a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 14 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.5 times at full reach, with a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Croaking Ripple
fusions.desc: Sends a croaking ripple out from you that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Dampened Leap
fusions.desc: Springs you 2 tiles away, and the healing you receive rises by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Spring
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
